image.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: professional hairstyle-analysis teaching image for a mobile training app
Primary request: Create a realistic 2-by-2 contact sheet showing the CURRENT hairstyle of one fictional adult East Asian woman from four consistent views: front, exact right profile, exact left profile, and exact back. This is one current-state documentation image, not a makeover and not a before/after comparison.

Scene/backdrop: identical plain warm light-gray studio background in every panel, no salon tools, no furniture, no props.
Subject: the exact same fictional woman in every panel, early 30s, natural unretouched skin texture, neutral relaxed expression, ordinary realistic appearance. Her current hair is dark natural brown, medium density, fine-to-medium-looking strands, collarbone length. The first approximately 9–11 cm from the scalp looks mostly straight, smooth and relatively flat from grown-out new hair. Loose old-perm bends begin around the lower ear to jaw area and become clearer through the lower half; the surface wave is broad and relaxed while the inner nape area shows a slightly tighter irregular S-bend. Ends are unevenly wavy, a little dry-looking but not severely damaged, and spread where they meet the upper shoulders. The overall visual weight sits low, with limited crown lift. Show an honest current grown-out perm transition, not fresh uniform curls.
Hairline/style: slightly off-center natural part, no short bangs, long face-framing pieces, both sides worn down. No tucked hair.
Framing: show full head, complete hairstyle outline and baseline, full neck, both shoulders, and the upper chest in every panel.
Clothing: identical simple matte dusty-blue wide crew-neck top in all panels, no jewelry.
Style/medium: honest photorealistic studio reference photography, realistic individual strands, flyaways, pores and subtle everyday texture; no beauty filter, no glamour retouching.
Composition/layout: landscape 2-by-2 contact sheet with four equal panels separated by narrow neutral gutters. Top-left front, top-right exact right profile, bottom-left exact left profile, bottom-right exact back. Same camera height, scale, focal length, crop, posture, shoulder level and soft neutral daylight in every panel.
Output intent: current-condition evidence for advanced hairstylist training about straight new growth versus remaining old perm, length-to-shoulder interaction, and long-term design tradeoffs.
Constraints/invariants: same identity, head/face proportions, neck and shoulder proportions, clothing, hairstyle length, root-to-curl transition and lighting across all four panels. Only one adult person repeated across views. No labels, no text, no arrows, no watermark. Do not show a reference hairstyle, proposed design, haircut result, salon styling result or chemical service result.
Avoid: fresh uniform salon curls, curls starting at the scalp, highly defined ringlets, extreme frizz, wet hair, hair extensions, cropped head, hidden shoulders, three-quarter angles in place of true profiles, duplicated front views, inconsistent length or face, extra people, dramatic makeup, face reshaping, glossy advertising finish.
